title: Chapter 344 Sensible Lin Family
content:
Chapter 344 Sensible Lin Family

At this time, Lu Daosheng was extremely arrogant. He just rushed into the Lin family all the way, and his tone was still so rude.

This made even the head of the Lin family who had been in power for many years unable to hold back, with an angry look on his face.

"Boy, I don't know if you are a newborn calf who is not afraid of a tiger or if you are brave enough to eat the heart of a bear. If you want to die, I can help you."

The old man in a commoner on the side took a step forward, and a faint aura suddenly surged towards Lu Daosheng.

Lu Daosheng still had no expression on his face in response to this.

"I want to kill me? Just rely on the old guy next to you, that's going to disappoint you."

Hearing this, the girl beside the head of the Lin family couldn't help but shake her head slightly.

The head of the Lin family smiled, but his smile was very creepy.

"Old Ma, don't kill him, just kill him."

The head of the Lin family issued an order directly.

However, strangely, time passed by minute by minute, but the old man in a civilian side still did not move.

This made the head of the Lin family frown.

"Old Ma, are you old and have deaf ears?"

When he subconsciously turned his head to look at the old man in a civilian on the side, he couldn't help but feel shocked.

Bang!

The crutch fell off his hands and fell on the bluestone slab on the ground, making a crisp sound.

"Old Ma, you!"

I saw that at this moment, the old man in a common man had already lost his calmness and peace of mind at the beginning, and it was unfathomable.

The sweat of beans covered his old face, soaking his clothes, and his whole body couldn't help but tremble. His eyes were filled with creepy fear, and he looked straight at Lu Daosheng in the distance.

And all of this was just because Lu Daosheng looked at him.

"I said, he can't."

Lu Daosheng's dull voice sounded again.

This time, the head of the Lin family could not calm down. From the beginning to the anxiety now, all this only happened in a moment.

The old guy next to him has been following him for almost half his life.

The old man in a common man was also his greatest reliance.

But now, the old man in a common man was like this before he could take action.

There is no doubt that the strange man in front of him is extremely difficult.

At this time, Lu Daosheng had already begun to walk slowly towards him.

At this moment, he panicked.

"Grandpa, I, I'm afraid."

The girl beside her was already scared and shrank tightly behind him.

The rest of the people around were also suppressed by Lu Daosheng, but none of them dared to act rashly.

"you,,"

However, the imagined violence did not happen.

Lu Daosheng passed by the head of the Lin family and walked into the villa.

After a moment of silence, Lin Ye, the head of the Lin family, turned around with difficulty, and saw Lu Daosheng sitting calmly on the sofa in the living room, as if he was the owner of the villa.

At this time, the old man in a civil garment came back to his senses.

"Honor, I,"

"Okay, you go back first and protect the warmth."

"Where are you, the head of the family?"

"What, can you deal with him?"

Forestry's face gradually returned to calm.

He knew that Lu Daosheng definitely did not come for nothing, it must be that someone from the Lin family did something and offended the great god.

If the other party did not choose to take action, it means there is still room for negotiation.

Hearing the forestry words, the old man in a common man bowed his head slightly and stopped saying anything.

It is a fact that he can't deal with Lu Daosheng, and it's useless to follow forestry.

Immediately, Lin Ye, the head of the Lin family, limped into the living room alone with a cane.

"sit."

Lu Daosheng crossed his legs and stretched out his hand to the sofa on the other side.

forestry:......

This seems to be my home, forget it.

Lin Ye sat on the sofa on the other side and looked at Lu Daosheng, feeling uneasy.

"I don't know what my Lin family has done, but it angered you."

Seeing that Lu Daosheng didn't say anything, Forestry took the initiative to speak, breaking the tranquility in the living room.

However, the atmosphere was still silent.

Lu Daosheng sat quietly, not knowing whether he was thinking or deliberately silent.

The scene seemed to be still when time was pressed.

Lu Daosheng didn't speak, and Lin Ye didn't dare to move.

After a long time, Lu Daosheng looked at Linye, "What is the power of your Lin family in Yunshan City?"

Upon hearing this, Lin Ye immediately said, "Our Lin family is not afraid of anyone except the Li family."

"Have the Jiang family's industry already reached your Lin family's hands?"

Lu Daosheng asked again.

Jiang’s industry.

Lin Ye was stunned for a moment, and kept recalling the Jiang family's industry in his mind.

The Jiang family’s industry is not very big, for their Lin family.

But it seems that he really has a little impression.

Suddenly, he remembered something, "I remembered that the Jiang family's property was acquired by my grandson."

At that time, his grandson Lin Xu was yelling to buy the Jiang family's company. At that time, the Jiang family's company was basically out of reach and was in a state of indebtedness. However, because of his love for his grandson and their Lin family's great business, it was not bad. , so he allocated some money to Lin Xu.

If Lu Daosheng didn't ask, he would have forgotten about this matter.

At this time, Lu Daosheng suddenly said, "I forgot to introduce myself. My name is Lu Daosheng. I am Mr. Jiang's godson and Jiang Xiaoxiao's brother."

Hearing this, Lin Ye, the head of the Lin family, was shocked.

He naturally knew that Old Man Jiang.

After all, the Jiang family had a glorious time, almost on par with their Lin family.

But it fell down later.

And the mysterious young man in front of him turned out to be the godson of Old Man Jiang.

In an instant, he realized that the Jiang family was about to rise.

"I will return the Jiang family's property intact. From today on, I will give all help to the Jiang family."

Forestry made a decision immediately.

I have to say that his mind was spinning very quickly.

He knew what Lu Daosheng wanted.

Lu Daosheng nodded slightly and continued, "Your grandson, you're very dishonest recently."

Upon hearing this, Lin Ye was stunned and immediately took out the phone.

beep, beep, beep, beep,

"Hey, grandpa, what's wrong?"

"Baby, get over here immediately!"

......

On the other side.

Jiang Xiaoxiao quickly rushed back home.

"Grandpa, grandpa is in trouble!"

"What's wrong? I'm so panicked. Where is your brother?"

Mr. Jiang immediately took the wine in Jiang Xiaoxiao's arms into his hand, and then asked.

But at this time, Jiang Xiaoxiao's eyes were moist.

Then she told her what she had encountered on the road and what was related to Lin Xu.

"Brother Sheng must be in danger now. He will not be beaten to death by them, right?"

Upon hearing this, Mr. Jiang's expression suddenly became dark.

"Grandpa, why don't we call the police?"

Jiang Xiaoxiao was a little panicked at this moment.

At this time, Mr. Jiang took out the phone and said, "Don't be afraid Xiaoxiao, I'll call my friend, your brother will be fine."

When Jiang Xiaoxiao heard his grandfather's words, she felt relieved.

He knew that his grandfather knew many powerful figures, which was also the reason why their Jiang family was backward and their lives were still prosperous.

But later my grandfather fell ill and she was the only one left in the Jiang family, so the Jiang family completely collapsed.
